Name: Actually Alcoholic Pina Colada
Author: Pandappuccino
Description:
While working on another mod (which is taking a [i]while[/i] but I'm hoping others will like it), I noticed that the Piña Colada is, strangely, not an alcoholic beverage. This is a little strange to me since an actual piña colada is made with rum.

So, I made this little mod to change that! This little mod replaces the existing Piña Colada object data with one that includes the "Drunk" debuff, meaning you can get utterly smashed on fruity cocktails. I also decided to add in a way to make them yourself with 1 Coconut, 1 Pineapple, and 1 Sugar; you can buy the recipe from Gus in the summer.

Nothing fancy, just a quick little "can I do this without breaking things" mod. Provided as-is.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Actually Alcoholic Piña Colada
Manifest.Description: A simple tweak to make the Piña Colada actually alcoholic, and make it a craftable item.
